Cost sensitivity: want ~$0.0001-0.0005 per decision; batching helps cost but increases tail latency — they want hybrid policy.
Key asks: compare Dedicated A40 vs on-prem A100 performance; quantization options (q4, int8) with accuracy delta <1% on CTR metric.

Network: VPC peering required; strict egress logging; must demonstrate end-to-end latency including network hop.
POC success criteria: meet p99 target under production-like burst profile (50k TPS bursts for 30s), no more than 10% quality regression after quantization, and cost target within forecast range.
